newsitem.title: USA: Matthews Q1 hurt by graphics unit.
newsitem.headline: Matthews Q1 hurt by graphics unit.

text.p: Matthews International Corp, which reported slightly higher first quarter earnings, said on Monday that its results for the period ended December 31, 1996 were hurt by its graphic systems segment.
The company said that its graphic systems unit's results fell below those of last year.
Matthews said that its earnings of $0.49 a share on sales of $42.6 million were in line with analysts' expectations.

The results reflected higher than forecast sales from marking products, stronger performance from the bronze segment, higher investment income and a slightly lower than forecast effective tax rate, Matthews said.
